<parameter=content>
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

FILE="version.json"

# Read current values using python for robust JSON parsing
read -r major minor patch < <(python3 -c "
import json
v=json.load(open('$FILE'))
print(v['major'], v['minor'], v['patch'])
")

# Bump patch
patch=$((patch + 1))

# Write back version.json
python3 -c "
import json
v=json.load(open('$FILE'))
v['patch']=${patch}
json.dump(v, open('$FILE','w'))
open('$FILE','a').write('\n')
"

# Write tag.txt
echo "v${major}.${minor}.${patch}" > tag.txt

</parameter>
